validJson: No errors · changes apply right away
v1Callout: This is an old {v1} form. Convert it in the {tab} tab.
jsonHint: Edits here and in the builder stay in sync. Fields use {keys}
libraryUrlHint: Where the form script loads from. Defaults to the npm CDN.
allLanguagesHint: Visitors see their browser's language if you have it, otherwise {language}.
switcherFlags: The form shows a flag switcher.
switcherDropdown: The form shows a language dropdown.
switcherNone: No language switcher. Add one in Build → Form settings → Languages.
stripOff: Keeps all languages and shows {language} using language="{code}".
importIntro: Paste or upload a form file. {v1} from the old form generator are converted automatically, with a list of what changed.
showHidden: Show fields that v1 would have hidden
showHiddenHint: The old version hid fields not marked "visible": true. Turn off to keep them hidden.
terminalHint: You can also run {command} in the form-generator repo.
iframeIntro: Paste this code where you want the form on your website. Works with WordPress, Webflow, Wix and more.
iframeUrlHosted: Your form's link. It works once you publish.
iframeAuto: Fit the height to the form
iframeAutoOn: Recommended. The height adjusts to the form, so there's no extra scrollbar.
iframeAutoOff: A fixed height, for sites that block scripts. Long forms scroll inside it.
